lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆Commander★ I got the footage you sent me☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Perhaps I'm overthinking things, but I didn't sense any emotion coming from your co-star's eyes☆
That's because she's so overcome with grief.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Ah, I see! ★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆In moments of true despair, sometimes even tears won't fall★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Now that you mention it☆ the more I watch this footage, the more emotional it seems★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Ohoh!☆ I've got a great idea!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Wracked with grief, our heroine still pushes forward.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Never failing in her sworn mission to recapture the surface.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: All the while, she thinks of her dearly departed Commander.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: But to her, the Commander is not dead, for those who pass on always live in our hearts☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: My goodness, what a magnificent ending! ★
Congratulations.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: This is all because of you, Commander★☆★☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I must hurry and write this down while it's still fresh★
Looking forward to seeing it on the screen.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Hehe, you really are a fan of my work, aren't you?★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆I'll be in touch when I know the air date☆★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Until next time!☆★☆★☆★☆★☆
